title: Shared repo/workspace/cache-root/generation helper family
problemStatement: Repo-root resolution, repo cache-root derivation, current-build selection, and index-root resolution were owned by tools/dict-utils/paths/repo.js even though src/** product code and src/shared/dict-utils.js depended on them. That cross-layer seam made correctness-critical generation/build-root logic effectively tool-owned.

duplicateClusters.name: Product code importing tool-side repo/build helpers
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Move repo/cache/build-resolution ownership into src/shared/repo-paths.js and reduce tools/dict-utils/paths/repo.js to an adapter that injects loadUserConfig/getCacheRoot defaults.

duplicateClusters.name: Tool wrapper performing shared work plus config defaulting
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Preserve the tool wrapper only as a compatibility adapter for config-loading defaults, not as the canonical owner of repo/build semantics.

duplicateClusters.name: src/shared compatibility shim masking tool ownership
duplicateClusters.bestFix: Stop blind export-star passthrough and make the shim explicitly re-export the real shared repo-path helpers plus only the remaining tool-local helpers still needed by tests.

whyCurrentSharedModulesWereInsufficient: src/shared/indexing/build-pointer.js already owned build-pointer interpretation, but not repo-root/cache-root/current-build entrypoints used across product surfaces.
src/workspace/config.js and src/workspace/manifest.js owned workspace semantics, but not generic repo cache/build path resolution.
tools/shared/dict-utils.js exposed the needed functions, but its ownership was wrong for src/** and caused a cross-layer dependency.

migrationsCompleted.notes: Now owns repo ID/root/cache/build/index path resolution and current-build generation selection.
Now delegates to src/shared/repo-paths.js and only injects config-loading defaults.

nonGoals: Move config loading out of tools/dict-utils/config.js in this issue.
Replace every remaining tools/shared/dict-utils.js import in one pass.
Change API trust-boundary or workspace selection policy.
followOnDeletionTargets: Further reduce src/shared/dict-utils.js compatibility exports once test/helpers move to direct shared owners.
Continue migrating remaining src/** imports off tools/shared/dict-utils.js where the imported helper now lives in src/shared/repo-paths.js.
